title: Telemetry that stops changing is detected, reported and recorded
purpose: Data that keeps arriving but no longer changes must not be shown as current. The operator must be warned and the event preserved. Requirement R-DATA-1.
expected_behaviour: A critical telemetry.frozen alert appears within 4 s of the data freezing. The frozen snapshots are labelled as injected. An incident package is produced and verifies. The vehicle continues its mission.

criteria.description: No telemetry alert before the fault
criteria.expected: no alert starting with ['nav.', 'telemetry.', 'battery.implausible', 'control.', 'security.', 'link.', 'gps.'] before the fault
alert telemetry.frozen within 4 s of the fault
altered data is labelled as injected

criteria.description: The mission is not interrupted by the monitors

criteria.expected: the incident package verifies against its manifest

criteria.description: The record of what AEGIS saw during the event is complete
criteria.observed: 100% of the expected state records; 0 s with none

criteria.description: The fault causes no other monitored alert (no false alarms)
criteria.expected: no monitored alert other than the ones this fault should cause

criteria.description: After the test the operator's Return works; the vehicle lands
criteria.expected: after the test, the operator's Return is accepted and the vehicle lands and disarms

incident_completeness.note: A record without a link holds the last values AEGIS had, marked connected=false; it is not a measurement of the vehicle.

limitations: The freeze repeats one snapshot inside AEGIS; the simulator keeps producing fresh data.
The fault is injected into AEGIS's copy of the telemetry; the vehicle itself keeps receiving correct data.
One run under one set of conditions. It does not show behaviour under other conditions, and it is not a safety certification.
